---
name: Factual, source, or date correction
about: Report a current factual error, source problem, date mismatch, or analytical-boundary defect
title: "[Correction] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Affected path and revision
Identify the current artifact, statement, table, or registry entry and the observed revision.

## Exact statement or field
Quote only the minimum text needed to identify the issue.

## Correcting evidence
Provide primary, official, or original-research sources where available, with relevant event/publication dates.

## Date boundary
Separate event date, source publication/update date, and repository observation date.

## Classification impact
State whether the correction changes a fact, attributed external claim, repository analysis, uncertainty, or source status.

## Historical preservation
If the affected item is a historical observation record, explain whether a new correction/reconciliation should supersede the interpretation rather than rewriting the original observation.

## Sensitive material
Do not submit credentials, private information, full paywalled text, or non-public evidence.
